brief: Prioritise Kelvedon Vale 230/34kV (SUB-SGW-408) for pre-event attention ahead of a younger unit because its advanced age and history of high loading leave it with a reduced margin against mechanical failure (MG-023). If this ageing unit cannot be attended before the heat event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure (MG-023). Record every de-rating applied, including the reason, the value, and the period (MG-021).
